description: He wears an ankle-length brown textured open-front coat with gold geometric woven borders along the front, cuffs and hem. A cream lightweight long tunic with an embroidered split neckline appears underneath, over loose cream trousers. A dark brown and gold woven sash circles the waist, with a long fringed end hanging down the front. The coat has full roomy sleeves and the tunic underlayer is visible at the wrists. Brown decorated closed leather shoes complete the outfit. All layers are opaque and practical with refined ornament. No headgear, veil, weapon or armor appears; precise fabric fibers cannot be verified.
